scope: Freshly written, not pulled from Gamma. Problems with no authored JS/Python pair in clocksmith/gamma catalogue/authored at head dd7dd823, verified against authored set and all previous batch bundles, no overlaps found. Only 10 problems in IDs 2201-2350 meet the simple-input constraints: 123 of 150 IDs in the range are already authored, and the remaining non-authored IDs are mostly SQL, class designs, tree problems, or a hard grid problem. This is not a claim of Gamma official independent admission.
qualification_method: For each problem: public examples plus 20 random cross-language agreement checks per problem, JS via node and Python via import, outputs compared. Two initial public-test expectations for 2269 were corrected during qualification (430043 is divisible by 43, and for (300, 1) only the digit 3 divides 300); both solutions agreed throughout and no solution was changed for those failures.
